instruction: A box of parts is counted in groups. When counted in groups of 5, 3 parts are left over. When counted in groups of 7, 4 parts are left over. When counted in groups of 11, 5 parts are left over. What is the smallest positive number of parts with this property? Compute it with the bash tool (python3 -c). Work only inside the current directory. When you are done, write ONLY the final answer to the file answer.txt in the current directory (for example with bash: echo 42 > answer.txt).
